name: Bird App
author: Frontier Lab Tycoon
description: FLT-69: researchers who post. Every researcher has a posting profile (a tier, an archetype, a spice level and a parody handle); each day some of them post, and the Bird App decides: flop, banger, controversy, ratioed or cancelled. Everything they say, and how everyone reacts, is a row in content.birdapp (kind: archetype, post or event); the numbers are in rules.birdapp. FLT-92: the rival labs post too: each lab's voices (kind: voice) say rival lines (kind: rival) on their own beats and yours; the numbers are rules.birdapp.rivals. Wakes at Level 3.
